# TeamForge

> TeamForge is an open-source real-time collaboration project for the Unity Editor. It explores live Scene synchronization, connected-user presence, same-Scene Hierarchy collaboration, locking and ownership, and P2P project bootstrap and transfer.

Use the TeamForge website endpoints below when an AI tool, coding agent, or URL-retrieval system needs current project information without depending on GitHub's rendered `blob` pages. These endpoints are generated from the canonical repository files during GitHub Pages deployment.

## Current project information

- [Project metadata](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/project.json): Current package version, source commit, project status, canonical repository, and machine-readable documentation URLs.
- [Current status](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/status.txt): Current capabilities, validation state, limitations, and public-alpha readiness gates.
- [Development history and changelog](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/changelog.txt): Version milestones plus the detailed Unity package changelog.
- [Roadmap](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/roadmap.txt): Planned direction; roadmap items are not release promises.
- [Source guide](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/source.txt): Guide to the public source tree and review entry points.
- [Architecture decisions](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/architecture.txt): Technical decisions, constraints, and tradeoffs.
- [Full AI-readable context](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/llms-full.txt): Curated current documentation bundled into one plain-text file.

## Historical development records

- [Phase notes index](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/history/phases/index.txt): Phase 0 through Phase 4 development records mirrored as plain text.
- [Work-state notes index](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/history/work-state/index.txt): Historical implementation, debugging, hotfix, decision, and handoff notes mirrored as plain text.

Historical work-state notes may be rough, partially superseded, or describe experiments that later changed. Prefer `project.json`, `status.txt`, and `changelog.txt` for current facts.

## Human-facing and source links

- [TeamForge website](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/): Human-facing project overview and development history.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab): Canonical source repository.
- [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/discussions): Questions, ideas, and open-ended project discussion.
- [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/issues): Bugs, feedback, and tracked work.

## Important interpretation notes

- TeamForge is an early public preview, not a generally recommended production collaboration layer.
- Open source does not imply that a build is independently security-audited or safe from data loss.
- Version, status, and validation claims should be checked against the generated current-information endpoints above rather than inferred from older work-state notes.
- The project uses substantial AI assistance; implementation claims should be evaluated through source, tests, reports, and real-world validation rather than authorship assumptions.
